concept.title: Help at home for an older person
concept.shortdesc: As an older person or their family, I need help at home with personal care and daily tasks, so that I can stay independent.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-028). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Who: older people, families of older people, people needing care.
Situation: Care needs growing; unsure what exists or who pays.
A good result: Home care, practical help and how to arrange and fund each, with the assessment route.
How much it matters: Important: a miss leaves someone without help they need.

ul.li: help with washing and dressing at home
help with shopping and housework for an older person

section.title: How the draft did on this need
section.p: Model-judged, in four places, with no human check yet. See for how to read it.
